name: form-and-flow
description: Fitness and food coach for India: Expo app, Supabase, and an AI coach whose numbers come from tested code

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ff/engines && npm run typecheck -w app && tsc -p supabase/functions/tsconfig.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tools/render-moves/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:db && npm run test:app
scripts.build:web: npm run export:web -w app && node scripts/write-sw.mjs app/dist
